alate: Body uniformly dark brown, head capsule darker, postclypeus dark brown or paler, the pale yellow stripe between the ocelli indistinct, pronotum with a pale T marking; legs yellowish brown. Body length with wings 8.52 to 9.63 mm, body length 5.68 to 6.60 mm. Head capsule elliptical, slightly longer than wide, length 0.85 to 0.92 mm, width 0.80 to 0.85 mm; fontanelle small, Y suture indistinct. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 3 shortest, segment 2 twice segment 3. Eye projection rate 14 per cent, the distance to the ventral margin of the head about a little more than half its long diameter. Ocelli oval, about 0.07 mm long, their distance to the compound eyes almost equal to their long diameter. Postclypeus slightly arched, the median line dark, median length 0.25 to 0.27 mm. Pronotum trapezoidal, length 0.43 to 0.48 mm, width 0.71 to 0.76 mm, the anterior margin slightly tilted up, the posterior margin distinctly concave in the middle. Hind tibia 0.95 to 1.02 mm long.
biology: It builds tower-like mounds up to human height on the ground, or globular nests on tree trunks; it is the dominant termite in the coastal primary Vatica woodland between Wushi and Yangmei in Wanning, Hainan, and bores into Vatica trees and the wooden posts of thatched houses.
soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown tinged with red, the frontal region slightly darker; antennae yellow; pronotum pale yellow, abdomen paler. A few long hairs borne on the head capsule. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin rather straight; frontal angles visible, the dorsal margin of the head nearly flat. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 shortest, segment 2 longer than segment 3. Labrum parallel-sided, the anterior margin straight or slightly narrowed forwards, with three pairs of short setae. Mandibles sickle-shaped, stout and rather curved; the serrations of the inner margin finer in front of the mandibular base and becoming indistinct towards the apex, the re-entrant of the outer margin at the base rather shallow; the middle of the postmentum distinctly projecting in lateral view, the waist region at the posterior third; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly incised, the posterior margin almost straight. Small soldier compared with the large one: mandibles slender and slightly straighter, with a coarse tooth on the inner margin near the basal third, mandible length 0.72 to 0.83 mm, against 0.62 to 0.71 mm in the large form; the middle of the postmentum flatter, head height 0.82 to 0.85 mm, against 0.89 to 1.02 mm in the large form.
